title: The Meeting
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael faces anxiety about an upcoming medical procedure and feels excluded from a private meeting between David Wallace and Jim, leading him to take unorthodox measures to stay involved. Meanwhile, tensions rise as Dwight doubts Darryl's injury story, resulting in mutual complaints. Jim is ultimately promoted to co-manager alongside Michael, causing mixed reactions among the staff. Subplots include Andy's distracted sales performance and wedding RSVP discussions among Pam, Kelly, and Meredith.

main_threads.thread: Michael's anxiety about his colonoscopy and his attempts to stay involved in office decisions despite being excluded from meetings.
